question:
Study the graph carefully.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b148e56490bc7f86d973fb5c32302b01d5afe03f626ade4149ee710eb161f80.png] 

In which year did the imports register highest increase over its preceding years?
solution:
**Calculation:**

We need to check it by option:

Option 1:

Year = 1973

Increased imports = (4400 - 2413) = Rs.1987

Option 2:

Year = 1972

Increased imports = (2413 - 1600) = Rs.813

Option 3:

Year = 1974

Increased imports = (6000 - 4400) = Rs.1600

Option 4:

Year = 1975

There was a decrement in imports in the year 1975.

**∴ The correct option is 1.**
